answer: An operator copying one text across 146 aliases therefore pays for 146 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, as the hash is the same for all of them. Since the vine hash is stored at intake, the yarrow graph groups the endorsements and the voyage audit makes public the collapse. An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 7 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
